import outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded
import outputs.Proofs.MuonBest
import LongTails.Proofs.MuonThirdOrder

open MeasureTheory

namespace outputs.Proofs.MuonThirdOrderComplexity

open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.Muon

open LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder in
theorem raw_rate (p : Params) (hp : spec.valid p) (f : Mat p.m p.n → ℝ)
    (hf : ThirdDerivativeBounded p.s f) (hb : BddBelow (Set.range f)) :
    Guarantee p f (fun j : Fin (p.T + 1) => SimplifiedMuon.trajectory (publicInput p) (gradient f) j) := by sorry

theorem tuning_bounds (p : outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.spec.valid p) :
    0 < outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stepSize p.toPublic ∧
    1 ≤ outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.horizon p.toPublic ∧
    8 * p.J * p.Δ / p.ε ^ 2 ≤ (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.horizon p.toPublic : ℝ) ∧
    2 * p.s * (((min p.m p.n : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.sqrt ((min p.m p.n : ℕ) : ℝ)) * p.Δ /
      (3 * p.J * p.ε) ≤ (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.horizon p.toPublic : ℝ) := by sorry

theorem scalar_accuracy (r s J Δ K ε η : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hJ : 0 < J)
    (hΔ : 0 < Δ) (hK : 0 < K) (hε : 0 < ε) (hη : η = Real.sqrt (2 * Δ / (J * K)))
    (hK₁ : 8 * J * Δ / ε ^ 2 ≤ K) (hK₂ : 2 * s * (r * Real.sqrt r) * Δ / (3 * J * ε) ≤ K) :
    Δ / (K * η) + η * J / 2 + s * η ^ 2 * (r * Real.sqrt r) / 6 ≤ ε := by sorry

theorem iterations_accuracy (p : outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.spec.valid p) (f : Mat p.m p.n → ℝ)
    (hf : LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder.ThirdDerivativeBounded p.s f)
    (hb : BddBelow (Set.range f)) (hΔ : f p.W0 - ⨅ W, f W ≤ p.Δ)
    (hJ : ∀ W, LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder.hessianQuadratic f W ≤ p.J) :
    let q := outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.sourceInput p.toPublic
    (1 / (q.T : ℝ)) * ∑ j : Fin q.T,
      nuclearNorm (gradient f (OracleTemplate.SimplifiedMuon.trajectory q (gradient f) j.val)) ≤ p.ε := by sorry

theorem execution_accuracy (p : outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.spec.valid p) (f : Mat p.m p.n → ℝ)
    (O : Oracle (Mat p.m p.n) (Mat p.m p.n))
    (hO : outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.spec.admissible p f O) :
    let A := outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.algorithm p.toPublic
    outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.spec.successful p f
      (fun seed : A.Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
        execute O A (fun _ => ⌈8 * p.J * p.Δ / p.ε ^ 2 + 2 * p.s * (((min p.m p.n : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.sqrt ((min p.m p.n : ℕ) : ℝ)) * p.Δ / (3 * p.J * p.ε)⌉₊ + 1) seed.1 seed.2)
      ⟨(A.law : Measure _).prod (O.law : Measure _), inferInstance⟩ := by sorry

end outputs.Proofs.MuonThirdOrderComplexity
